select id, business_id, field_vmodel, related_business_id, related_template_id, related_business_no, create_id, create_time from t_workflow_related_approval where related_business_id = #{relatedBusinessId} order by create_time desc

select d.biz_id as business_id, d.biz_title as business_no, d.template_id as template_id, t.name as template_name, d.biz_title as title, d.status as status, d.create_time as create_time from t_workflow_my_draft d join t_template t on t.id = d.template_id where d.del_flag = '0' and t.del_flag = '0' and t.enable_flag = '1' and d.create_id = #{userId} and d.template_id in #{tid} and ifnull(t.type, '') = ifnull(#{hostType}, '')
and (d.biz_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or d.biz_id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by d.create_time desc limit 50

select d.biz_id as business_id, d.biz_title as business_no, d.template_id as template_id, t.name as template_name, d.biz_title as title, d.status as status, d.create_time as create_time from t_workflow_my_draft d join t_template t on t.id = d.template_id where d.biz_id = #{businessId} and d.del_flag = '0' limit 1
